content: समान {%a.%} .²1 Same, one, equal, like, similar; नोपगच्छेत् प्रमत्तोऽपि स्त्रियमार्तवदर्शने . समानशयने चैव न शयीत तया सह .. <ls>Ms. 4. 40</ls>; भुजे भुजंगेन्द्रसमानसारे <ls>R. 2. 74</ls>; समानशीलव्यसनेषु सख्यम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 One, uniform. .²3 Good, virtuous, just. .²4 Common, general. .²5 Honoured. .²6 Middling, moderate. .²7 Whole (as a number). .{@-नः@} .²1 A friend, an equal. .²2 One of five life-winds or vital airs, which has its seat in the cavity of the navel and is essential to digestion. .²3 A letter having the same organ of utterance. .{@-नम्@} {%ind.%} Equally with, like (with <ab>instr.</ab>); जलधरेण समानमुमापतिः <ls>Ki. 18. 4</ls>.
